advanced-tuck-back-lever.note: Shown at the full back lever.

advanced-tuck-front-lever.note: Shown at the full front lever.

advanced-tuck-front-lever-row.note: Shown at the full front lever. The row starts from this position.

archer-push-up.note: Shown as a wide push-up. Shift toward one hand and keep the other arm straight.

armor-building-complex.note: Shown at the rack position with two kettlebells.

assisted-squat.note: Shown without support. Hold a post or a band to take some of your weight.

band-assisted-nordic-curl.note: Shown as a natural glute ham raise, the same kneeling lean. A band takes some of the load.

band-dislocate.note: Shown with a stick behind the back. Use a band the same way.

band-face-pull.note: Shown with a cable. Use a band the same way.

bodyweight-romanian-deadlift.note: Shown with a barbell. Hinge the same way with your arms hanging.

box-pistol-squat.note: Shown as a full pistol squat. Sit back onto a box instead of going all the way down.

box-step-up.note: Shown with dumbbells. Step onto a box the same way.

chest-to-bar-pull-up.title: File:2008 CrossFit Games - Brandon doing chest-to-bar pull-ups.jpg

cossack-squat.note: Shown with a barbell, in a wide side squat. Hold no weight, or one at your chest.

couch-stretch.note: Shown as a kneeling hip flexor stretch. Put the back foot up on a wall or couch.

dead-hang.note: Shown at the start of a pull-up. Hold that straight-arm hang.

deep-goblet-squat-hold.note: Shown mid squat. Hold the weight at your chest at the bottom.

deficit-push-up.title: File:Girl doing push-ups from the side.jpg

double-kettlebell-clean-and-press.note: Shown at the rack position with two kettlebells.

dumbbell-hip-thrust.note: Shown with a barbell. Rest a dumbbell across your hips.

dumbbell-pullover-stretch.note: Shown with the bent arm pullover. Lower the weight behind your head for the stretch.

dumbbell-rdl-stretch-hold.note: Shown with a barbell. Hold a dumbbell in each hand and pause at the stretch.

dumbbell-single-leg-romanian-deadlift.note: Shown with a kettlebell. Hold a dumbbell the same way.

eccentric-nordic-curl.note: Shown as a natural glute ham raise, the same kneeling lean.

elevated-pike-push-up.note: Shown at the wall handstand push-up. Keep your feet on a box instead.

explosive-pull-up-and-dip.note: Shown as the bar muscle-up: the pull-up, then the dip.

feet-elevated-inverted-row.note: Shown with the feet on the floor. Rest your heels on a bench for this one.

freestanding-handstand-practice.note: Shown with the heels against a wall. Hold it free of the wall.

half-lay-back-lever.note: Shown at the full back lever.

hamstring-walkout.note: Shown at the top of a bridge. Walk your heels out from there.

hanging-bent-leg-raise.note: Shown as a hanging leg raise. Keep your knees bent as you lift.

hanging-knee-raise.note: Shown as a hanging leg raise. Bend your knees as you lift.

heels-elevated-goblet-squat.note: Shown with the heels flat. Raise them on small plates.

hip-cars.note: Shown as a standing hip circle.

incline-row.note: Shown on a bar in a rack. Set the bar at about chest height.

kettlebell-curl.note: Shown with dumbbells. Hold a kettlebell the same way.

kettlebell-reverse-fly.note: Shown with dumbbells. Hold kettlebells the same way.

kettlebell-swing.note: Shown one-handed. Hold the bell with both hands.

knee-push-up.note: Shown on the toes. Rest your knees on the floor for this one.

negative-dip.note: Shown at the dip. Lower yourself slowly from the top.

negative-muscle-up.note: Shown at the top. Lower slowly from there.

negative-pull-up.note: Shown at the pull-up. Lower yourself slowly from the top.

one-leg-front-lever.note: Shown at the full front lever.

planche-lean.note: Shown at the full planche. Lean the same way with your feet on the floor.

ring-biceps-curl.note: Shown as a ring row. For the curl, keep your elbows still and bend only at the elbow.

ring-muscle-up.note: Shown on rings at the start of the muscle-up.

ring-row.title: File:Man performing inverted row with suspension trainer.jpg

shoulder-cars.note: Shown as a standing shoulder circle.

shrimp-squat.note: Shown as a pistol squat. In a shrimp squat the rear foot is held behind you.

single-leg-calf-raise.note: Shown on both legs. Do it on one leg, the other foot lifted.

standing-ab-wheel-rollout.note: Shown from the knees. Roll out from standing the same way.

straddle-back-lever.note: Shown at the full back lever.

straddle-front-lever.note: Shown at the full front lever.

straddle-front-lever-row.note: Shown at the full front lever. The row starts from this position.

support-hold.note: Shown at the top of a dip. Hold that straight-arm position.

thoracic-open-book.note: Shown lying on the side with one arm open.

toes-to-bar.note: Shown as a hanging leg raise. Bring your toes all the way to the bar.

tuck-back-lever.note: Shown at the full back lever.

tuck-front-lever.note: Shown at the full front lever.

tuck-front-lever-row.note: Shown at the full front lever. The row starts from this position.

v-sit.note: Shown as the L-sit. Lift the legs higher, toward vertical.

vertical-row.note: Shown at a lower angle. Stand more upright for the vertical row.

wall-push-up.note: Shown with the hands on a box. Stand and push against a wall instead.

wide-grip-inverted-row.note: Shown with a regular grip. Take the bar wider than your shoulders.
